title: ActionAccessSpecification
description: A set of requirements that must be fulfilled in order to perform an Action.

type.title: Type
type.description: The RDF type(s) of this item.

availabilityEnds.title: Availability Ends
availabilityEnds.description: The end of the availability of the product or service included in the offer.

availabilityStarts.title: Availability Starts
availabilityStarts.description: The beginning of the availability of the product or service included in the offer.

category.title: Category
category.description: A category for the item. Greater signs or slashes can be used to informally indicate a category hierarchy.

category_text.title: Category (text)
category_text.description: A category for the item. Greater signs or slashes can be used to informally indicate a category hierarchy.

eligibleRegion.title: Eligible Region
eligibleRegion.description: The ISO 3166-1 (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2) or ISO 3166-2 code, the place, or the GeoShape for the geo-political region(s) for which the offer or delivery charge specification is valid.\n\nSee also [[ineligibleRegion]].

items.$comment: NOTE[mixed range]: GeoShape [value-type]: GeoShape -> StructuredValue -> Intangible -> Thing; Place [entity]: Place -> Thing

eligibleRegion_text.title: Eligible Region (text)
eligibleRegion_text.description: The ISO 3166-1 (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2) or ISO 3166-2 code, the place, or the GeoShape for the geo-political region(s) for which the offer or delivery charge specification is valid.\n\nSee also [[ineligibleRegion]].

expectsAcceptanceOf.title: Expects Acceptance Of
expectsAcceptanceOf.description: An Offer which must be accepted before the user can perform the Action. For example, the user may need to buy a movie before being able to watch it.

ineligibleRegion.title: Ineligible Region
ineligibleRegion.description: The ISO 3166-1 (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2) or ISO 3166-2 code, the place, or the GeoShape for the geo-political region(s) for which the offer or delivery charge specification is not valid, e.g. a region where the transaction is not allowed.\n\nSee also [[eligibleRegion]].

items.$comment: NOTE[mixed range]: GeoShape [value-type]: GeoShape -> StructuredValue -> Intangible -> Thing; Place [entity]: Place -> Thing

ineligibleRegion_text.title: Ineligible Region (text)
ineligibleRegion_text.description: The ISO 3166-1 (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2) or ISO 3166-2 code, the place, or the GeoShape for the geo-political region(s) for which the offer or delivery charge specification is not valid, e.g. a region where the transaction is not allowed.\n\nSee also [[eligibleRegion]].

requiresSubscription.title: Requires Subscription
requiresSubscription.description: Indicates if use of the media require a subscription  (either paid or free). Allowed values are ```true``` or ```false``` (note that an earlier version had 'yes', 'no').

requiresSubscription_text.title: Requires Subscription (text)
requiresSubscription_text.description: Indicates if use of the media require a subscription  (either paid or free). Allowed values are ```true``` or ```false``` (note that an earlier version had 'yes', 'no').
